verdict.rationale: n8n documents self-hosting on your own infrastructure, on-premises, or in a private cloud, which lets users decide where workflow data lives. A community user confirms self-hosting avoids client-data restrictions that rule out hosted tools. However, nothing shows region or residency selection for n8n's own Cloud offering; residency control comes only through self-hosting. Missing for 10: cloud region/data-residency selection, explicit data residency documentation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
